# Deep Dive: Treasury Inflation Protected Securities

Report 121 | Published 2023-10-15 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2023-10-15/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/121.json)

TIPS entry, fiscal transmission, and energy insurance.

The TIPS entry earned positive returns but did not beat nominal intermediate Treasuries over the two-year sensitivity. Broad equity caution proved too pessimistic. The report usefully concedes the earlier Fed-hawkishness miss, while the revised claim that higher rates are net inflationary remains unproven. TIPS principal protection needs a par-value qualification. Energy-disruption risk materialized within the decade, without validating every intermediate geopolitical scenario.

**Coverage:** Read all blocks 0-166 and 17 image labels. Includes liquidity timing, BTC supply/demand, tokenization, allocation changes, fiscal-interest mechanism, detailed TIPS contract/risk math, inflation spectrum and geopolitical energy scenarios. Historical quotations identified as recaps, not new independent wins.

## Framework lessons

- Separate contract protection from market-price and opportunity-cost risks.
